task: v_hyp_private R25P-6 (mc25 re-run of mc23 finals-pair MC)
reason: The numbers reproduce (seed 11: A .705/.447, B .762/.511, C .618/.439), but the claim to be put on the card does not hold as worded: that the CI crossover (+0.0001) is the single assumption deciding B vs A. (1) The crossover also depends on the CI sd. The finding's own cross run used sd 0.0009, not the base 0.0008. Re-runs of mc25 (base / qpub0): at CI N(+0.0002, 0.0012), B-A bronze is -0.007 / -0.003. At N(+0.0005, 0.0015), the bronze edge shrinks from +0.057 to +0.003. At N(0, 0.0015) it is -0.045. The bronze crossover moves from +0.0001 (sd 0.0009) to about +0.00025 (sd 0.0012) and about +0.0005 (sd 0.0015). A wide sd is at least as defensible as 0.0008: the public read is one embryo, and the 3-decimal rounding gives a true delta anywhere in (0, 0.002). The lab per-clip CI spread is -0.021..+0.0125, and ci_zshift_out.json shows 44b6_c50204e0 losing J at alpha 0.5 (0.8605 -> 0.8576). (2) 'B > A > C in all 7 scenarios' overstates robustness. The 7 scenarios vary only the field and q, and keep CI fixed at N(+0.0005, 0.0008). The one term that decides B vs A is never varied inside them, because B and A differ only in whether the second file carries CI. (3) The mc20 cap term is 'unchanged'. It predates probes 47 and 49 (cap 8 = 0.955, cap 12 '-'), and it is a coin flip (P(C<0) = 0.51). The B > A > C order does survive a lower cap mean (C N(+0.0003, 0.0012): B .774 > A .754 > C .705). (4) I-092: the result is judgmental priors in and a ranking out. It has no out-of-sample content about unseen embryos. What survives is that B beats A on SILVER in every run, including a CI mean of 0 (+0.03..+0.07). On BRONZE it is a tie at honest CI widths. Feasibility is fine: no build or slot, and R1-R10 are untouched. But pair B exists only if exp75 gets a pre-02:00Z CI slot and reads COMPLETE, per R25P-3 and R25P-5.
fix: Put the table on the card with two assumptions, not one. Write: 'B beats A on bronze only if the private CI mean is above about +0.0001 (sd 0.0009), +0.00025 (sd 0.0012) or +0.0005 (sd 0.0015). B beats A on silver in every run, including CI mean 0.' Replace 'B > A > C in all 7 scenarios' with 'B > A > C across the 7 field/q scenarios at CI N(+0.0005, 0.0008); the CI prior is the term that decides.' Add the sd-0.0015 row (A .717/.467, B .720/.532) as the pessimistic range. Note that the cap term predates probes 47 and 49 (the order holds with C N(+0.0003, 0.0012)). Keep the I-092 wording: the model ranks and does not decide. Scripts: scratchpad r25/mc25.py with CI_MU/CI_SD env vars. Log: research/wf_ideas_v4/round25/v_hyp_private_r25p-6.notes.md.
realistic_gain: No score gain: this is card framing only. For choosing the finals pair, the honest range for B over A is about +0.00..+0.06 P(bronze), a tie at a wide CI sd, and +0.03..+0.07 P(silver). This is model-dependent (I-092) and conditional on exp75 being submitted and reading >= 0.955.
